objective: Improve macro-F1 while reporting accuracy and class-wise performance honestly
experiments: frozen MiniLM sentence embeddings with logistic regression
fine-tuned MiniLM text classifiers up to 5 epochs with early stopping
constraints: text only; no speaker label history or fact-check justifications as inputs
test already seen; final test is follow-up evaluation, not a new blind benchmark
stopping: complete defined candidate families; stop epochs after two validation non-improvements; do not chase test results
